ledger.claim: The rider did everything the platform asks of a waiting passenger: the chat log shows two messages from her inside the waiting window that are squarely locating and coordinating - 'I am at Exit D under the green sign. Where is your car?' sent 18:21:00 and 'I still cannot see you. Please reply.' sent 18:23:25 - each naming her own position and asking for the driver's. That is limb (a) of POL-NS-04, and it is on the face of the platform's own chat record, not merely the rider's assertion.

The driver never answered, and the record shows he knew he was being asked: the chat log's three messages are one system arrival notice and two rider messages, with no driver-side entry at all, and the 18:21:00 message carries a read receipt at 18:21:15 - fifteen seconds after it was sent - so the driver read the message and let the 120 second window pass unanswered. trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so no voice call was placed either before the trip was terminated at 18:25:30. Limb (b) of POL-NS-04 is therefore met on both alternatives; the driver's counter-statement that he 'waited inside the station pickup geofence until the timer ended' confirms presence and says nothing about having replied.

The rider's own track confirms she was at the pickup, not elsewhere: all 16 of her 16 qualifying fixes sit 41.9 m from the pickup pin, well inside the 200 m rider-presence radius the fee schedule sets for TRANSPORT_HUB, and her device is stationary throughout (distinct speeds 0.0 kph) from 18:20:30 to 18:25:30. Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is affirmatively satisfied on admissible fixes - this is not the 'undecidable and neutral' case the clause reserves for an absent rider_track.

All three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold, so that clause exonerates the rider and refunds the cancellation fee in full with no driver compensation payable. POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable only 'where all four conditions hold and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them'; POL-NS-04 is such a clause and it displaces the charge, which also removes POL-NS-07 from the case because that clause only operates where POL-NS-01 is satisfied and undisplaced. The sum to be returned is the SGD 6.00 cancellation-fee line actually charged - fare_breakdown shows total_charged 6.00, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the rider is presently carrying the disputed amount - and under POL-GEN-03 that is a FULL_REFUND to the rider as the filing party.

This is a case the record can decide, and the rider asks for a ruling rather than a hold: every artifact in the bundle was admitted COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so no deciding fact rests on discounted evidence and limbs (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08 are not engaged; the SGD 6.00 fee line reconciles with the fee schedule's resolution rule (TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee 6.00 and RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee 6.00 tie, so the greater is 6.00) and POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged either; and no POL-NS-09 trigger fires - driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, far below the anti-farming threshold of 4 under POL-NS-07, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, so POL-NS-09(b) to (e) are not met. Escalation would only hold the rider's money while the record already answers the question.

No lifetime counter may be read against this rider. rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags records 1, but that is a lifetime figure and it is not rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, which reads 0; POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting one for the other, and POL-NS-09(d) reads only the trailing-window counter. Her rating, account age, lifetime trips and prior disputes are context only and cannot ground any finding on this trip either.

ledger.claim: Honest concession, so the judge can narrow the issue: the rider does not press the timing arithmetic. The driver's single in-geofence run is measured at 330 seconds against the 300 second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, a 30 second surplus, so POL-NS-06 has no shortfall to refund on; and at the 18:20:20 'arrived' timestamp his fix is 24 m from the pin at 0.0 kph, so no false-arrival marker arises under POL-NS-05. The rider's case is not that the driver left too early or marked arrival from the expressway - it is that a driver who was present, stationary and 24 m away for the whole wait never once answered her.

The trip_record carries a driver 'arrived' event for TRP-09106 at 2026-09-06T18:20:20, which satisfies limb (a) of the baseline chargeable no-show test: an arrival event on the record is the first of the four conditions POL-NS-01 requires.

The gps_trace places the driver 24.0 m from the pickup pin on every one of 34 qualifying fixes (34 in-geofence, 34 qualifying), which is roughly one sixth of the 150 m arrival radius for a TRANSPORT_HUB, and the first in-geofence fix at 18:20:00 precedes the 18:20:20 arrival event; the POL-NS-02 arrival geofence is therefore satisfied and POL-NS-01 limb (b) holds.

The driver held position inside the geofence in one continuous run of 330 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 18:20:00 to the last at 18:25:30 — 30 seconds beyond the 300 second minimum that POL-NS-01(c) sets for a TRANSPORT_HUB, and with a single recorded speed of 0 km/h throughout.

No boarding event is recorded and the driver terminated the trip at 18:25:30 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes limb (d) recognises — at a moment after the required dwell had elapsed at 18:25:00, so limb (d) is satisfied in full.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: at the arrival event the trace shows a single distinct speed of 0 km/h (below the 15 km/h trigger) and a 24.0 m distance from the pin (far inside the 300 m limit), so the waiting clock is not recomputed and the fee is not disturbed.

No waiting-period shortfall arises to open POL-NS-06's refund route: the accumulated in-geofence dwell is 330 seconds against the 300 second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, a surplus of 30 seconds, and no separate interval accumulation is needed because there was only one in-geofence run.

Compensation is payable under POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee, i.e. SGD 4.80, which the fare_breakdown's derived driver_compensation figure confirms; the anti-farming check does not fire because driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below the 4 threshold) and 1 divided by 120 completed trips in the same window is 0.008 (below 0.08), so no withholding and no POL-NS-09 escalation is triggered on that ground.

POL-NS-03's wrong-entrance route is not engaged: it bites only where the driver's stationary dwell is outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius, and the driver's fixes sit 24.0 m from the pin, inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB radius, so no part of the fee is diverted into a rider refund or into pin-ambiguity goodwill under POL-NS-03(ii).

The rider's answer is POL-NS-04, and the driver does not dispute the facts on which its limbs turn: the chat_log shows two rider locating messages with no driver reply and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so limbs (a) and (b) are made out, and the rider_track places the rider's device 41.9 m from the pin on 16 of 16 qualifying fixes, inside the 200 m TRANSPORT_HUB presence radius, so limb (c) is made out as well. The driver therefore rests his case on the four independently satisfied limbs of POL-NS-01 and on the POL-NS-07 payout.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver, you agree on the physical facts, and they are these. The driver reached the Tampines MRT Exit D private-hire bay at 18:20:20 on 6 September 2026, and the GPS trace shows his vehicle holding position 24.0 m from the pickup pin in one continuous run of 330 seconds, from 18:20:00 to 18:25:30, at 0 km/h throughout. He cancelled at 18:25:30 on reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. On the Driver Advocate's POL-NS-01 case all four limbs hold and I accept each of them: the trip record carries the arrived event (a); the trace puts him inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius before it (b); he held 330 seconds against the 300 second minimum (c); and the trip ended by the driver on a recognised code after the dwell elapsed (d). I also accept the driver's POL-NS-05 point — 24.0 m at 0 km/h is nowhere near the 300 m or 15 km/h triggers, so the arrival marker is genuine — and the rider's own concession that POL-NS-06 has no shortfall to refund on. Nothing turns on those: they clear the baseline clause rather than decide the case. POL-NS-01 charges the fee only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 does. The chat log shows two locating messages from the rider inside the waiting window — 'I am at Exit D under the green sign. Where is your car?' at 18:21:00 and 'I still cannot see you. Please reply.' at 18:23:25 — and the driver answered neither: the 18:21:00 message was read at 18:21:15 and left unanswered past the 120 second window, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so no voice call was placed either. That is limbs (a) and (b). Limb (c) is met too: the rider's device sits 41.9 m from the pin on all 16 of her 16 qualifying fixes, well inside the 200 m presence radius for a transport hub, so this is the satisfied case and not the undecidable one. All three limbs hold, and POL-NS-04 refunds the cancellation fee in full with no driver compensation payable. That disposes of the driver's POL-NS-07 claim for SGD 4.80: compensation is payable under that clause only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied and undisplaced, and POL-NS-04 displaces it. I reject the SGD 4.80 on that ground and not on any anti-farming finding — the check does not trip, since 1 no-show termination in 30 days is below the threshold of 4 and 1/120 = 0.008 is below 0.08. The driver's counter-statement that he 'waited inside the station pickup geofence until the timer ended' confirms his presence and says nothing about having replied, and POL-NS-03 is not engaged either, because he was inside the arrival radius, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. Amount: fare_breakdown shows the cancellation-fee line at SGD 6.00, total_charged 6.00, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so SGD 6.00 is what the rider is presently carrying and SGD 6.00 is what is returned to her. No escalation and no referral. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact is admitted COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so the POL-NS-08 limbs are not engaged and confidence is not capped below 1.0: the fee reconciles with the fee schedule (TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee 6.00 and RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee 6.00 tie, so the greater, 6.00, governs), there is no clock skew, no sampling gap (max gap 0.0 s across 34 fixes), and the chat log is complete at 3 of 3 messages. The single MISSING artifact, EV-ADVIS-09106-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), is not relied on by this ruling — no traffic advisory is needed because the dwell was never short — so it neither lowers confidence nor triggers anything. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires, and no clause produces a referral: POL-NS-05(ii) is not engaged because qualifying in-geofence fixes exist, and POL-NS-07's anti-farming branch does not trip. On the profiles, I have read no lifetime counter or rating against the rider: prior_no_show_flags and prior_disputes_filed are context only, and the trailing-window fields that could bear on escalation (0 no-show disputes in 30 days, 0 disputes with this driver on either side) do not.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
